description: This file handles organization redirects in a web application, including logic for URL redirection based on organization context, single org mode, and dynamic URL construction with query parameters.

methods.name: getSearchString
methods.description: Extracts the search/query string from a URL.

methods.name: getTemporaryOrgRedirect
methods.description: Generates a redirect object based on organization slugs, redirect type, and query parameters, optionally using a relative path.

methods.name: handleOrgRedirect
methods.description: Main function to handle organization URL redirects, considering org context, single org mode, and previous redirects.

methods.name: getRedirectWithOriginAndSearchString
methods.description: Wraps handleOrgRedirect to include origin and search string extraction from the redirect destination.
